off.notice: Two phases: 240 frames with isolated cloud GPU queries, then 240 frames with whole-frame GPU queries. Whole-frame GPU spans scene and all postprocessing; CPU submission and rAF are separate. Compare whole-frame off/Low/High at the same pose. Isolated pass timings are diagnostic and not additive to whole-frame timing: query boundaries may alter scheduling or tile resolves on deferred GPUs. Differences of separate p95 summaries are not paired-frame p95 costs. Unsupported/disjoint GPU samples are not inferred.
